hebrew:
הִגָלֵה נָא וּפְרשׂ, חָבִיב

עָלַי אֶת סֻכַת שְלומָךְ
translation:
Reveal [yourself] please! Beloved, spread over me the shelter of your peace.

Translated literally by an anonymous editor of this page. The translation below is interpretive.

Help, my Lover, spread

Your canopy of peace.

Translation by Rabbi Zalman Schachter-Shalomi.
information:
